RPT-001Partial

Reporting data lineage from source transaction to submitted field

Core · Compliance OS · Owner: Regulatory Reporting

Acceptance boundary

Reporting data lineage from source transaction to submitted field is accepted when tenant-scoped execution fails closed on invalid authority or evidence, retains auditable lineage, and the cited automated control-family tests pass.

Current maturity and gap

Remaining gap for RPT-001: production-grade institutional configuration, external-provider or assessor evidence where applicable, and witnessed operating-effectiveness validation are not yet complete.

Dependencies

Review currency
